name: Scaling Efficiency
description: How does context size grow as conversation length increases? Linear growth = bad. Sublinear = good.
note: Run this at 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000 messages. Plot context_bytes vs message_count. The ideal curve is logarithmic.
query_at_end: Summarize the 3 most important facts from our conversation.

accuracy_at_scale.note: Must maintain >80% recall accuracy even at 1000 messages
